lines.trans: Is she not suited to finding a boyfriend?
She is suited to that too, except an ordinary guy will not do.
She should find someone just like you, Mr Chun Yuqiao.
Someone driven in his career who can also click with her in conversation.
Ideally a younger version of you.
A younger version?
Right, his status cannot be too high; ideally someone with great potential.
Someone who can grow alongside her so the two of them share common ground.
Are there any other criteria?
Ideally he should also be handsome, from a good family, and willing to spend time with his girlfriend.
All of a sudden you turned that into your own wish list.
Mr Chun Yuqiao, what would you like to drink? Let me pour it for you.
I am tired of plain water; let me try some coffee.
